speak.title: Role-play: choosing the holiday
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You have seen a list of fast-growing destinations. You want to book a week in one of them. Explain why it excites you and answer your friend's worries.

b.text: You think a trending place may be busy and expensive. Ask questions about prices, crowds and transport. Suggest a different place, or a different month.

phrases: I've just seen a list of places everyone's searching for.
It looks amazing, but isn't it going to be crowded?
What's the weather like at that time of year?
Let's compare the prices before we decide.
Could we meet halfway and go in September?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: where are you going, and who changed their mind?
